spec.rawSql: SELECT modbus_air_temperature_c AS "Air temperature" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT modbus_humidity_pct AS "Humidity" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT modbus_pressure_pa AS "Pressure" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT modbus_average_wind_speed_ms AS "Wind speed" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT modbus_average_wind_direction_deg AS "Wind direction" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT modbus_rain_intensity_mm_h AS "Rain intensity" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT modbus_solar_radiation_wm2 AS "Solar radiation" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT battery_voltage_v AS "Battery voltage" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND battery_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT CASE WHEN modbus_valid = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Modbus online" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT rssi AS "RSSI" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT snr AS "SNR" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_air_temperature_c AS "Air temperature" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_humidity_pct AS "Humidity" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_pressure_pa AS "Pressure" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_min_wind_speed_ms AS "Min", modbus_average_wind_speed_ms AS "Average", modbus_max_wind_speed_ms AS "Max" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_min_wind_direction_deg AS "Min", modbus_average_wind_direction_deg AS "Average", modbus_max_wind_direction_deg AS "Max" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_rain_intensity_mm_h AS "Intensity", modbus_max_rain_intensity_mm_h AS "Maximum", modbus_accumulated_rainfall_mm AS "Accumulated" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_solar_radiation_wm2 AS "Solar radiation", modbus_light_lux AS "Light" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_pm25_ug_m3 AS "PM2.5", modbus_pm10_ug_m3 AS "PM10", modbus_co2_ppm AS "CO2", modbus_noise_db AS "Noise" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} AND modbus_valid = TRUE ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", modbus_air_temperature_c AS "Air temp C", modbus_humidity_pct AS "Humidity %RH", modbus_pressure_pa AS "Pressure Pa", modbus_average_wind_speed_ms AS "Wind m/s", modbus_average_wind_direction_deg AS "Wind deg", modbus_rain_intensity_mm_h AS "Rain mm/h", modbus_accumulated_rainfall_mm AS "Rain total mm", modbus_solar_radiation_wm2 AS "Solar W/m2", modbus_pm25_ug_m3 AS "PM2.5", modbus_pm10_ug_m3 AS "PM10", modbus_co2_ppm AS "CO2 ppm", modbus_tilt_state_text AS "Tilt", rssi AS "RSSI", snr AS "SNR" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 20;
SELECT "timestamp" AS "time", rssi AS "RSSI dBm", snr AS "SNR dB" FROM public.multiconnect WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND controller_id = ${controller_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp";
SELECT DISTINCT controller_id FROM public.multiconnect ORDER BY controller_id;
